blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 Phase II 製造調查的啟動條件，以及跨部門調查團隊的組成與職責分工。
blocks.en: Understand the triggers for a Phase II manufacturing investigation, and the make-up and responsibilities of the cross-functional investigation team.

blocks.zh: 掌握根本原因分析（Root Cause Analysis）中魚骨圖框架的應用，並能識別所有六大 6M 類別。
blocks.en: Apply the fishbone framework in root cause analysis (RCA) and be able to identify all six 6M categories.

blocks.zh: 完整閱讀並理解 Table 5.1-1🔍 所列十大考量類別（從原料、人員到批次記錄），確保每一項都納入評估。
blocks.en: Read and understand the ten consideration categories listed in Table 5.1-1🔍 (from raw materials and personnel to batch records), so that every one is included in the evaluation.

blocks.zh: 區分「確定原因」、「最可能原因」、「可能原因」與「未知原因」四種調查結論等級，並了解其監管意涵。
blocks.en: Distinguish the four investigation conclusion levels - root cause, most probable cause, possible cause and unknown cause - and understand their regulatory implications.

blocks.zh: 理解 CAPA 計畫要素：到期日、責任人、電子追蹤系統，以及有效性查核（Effectiveness Check）的重要性。
blocks.en: Understand the elements of a CAPA plan: due dates, owners, an electronic tracking system, and the importance of an effectiveness check.

blocks.zh: 5.0 Phase II: Manufacturing Investigation — 製造調查概覽
blocks.en: 5.0 Phase II: Manufacturing Investigation - Overview

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 5.0 Phase II 概覽
blocks.en: Commentary - 5.0 Phase II Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Phase II 的啟動條件
blocks.en: Core concept: what triggers Phase II

blocks.zh: Phase I（實驗室調查）完成後，有兩種情況會觸發 Phase II：
blocks.en: Once Phase I (the laboratory investigation) is complete, two situations trigger Phase II:

blocks.zh: 已排除實驗室錯誤：Phase I 確認偏差真實存在，必須往製造端追查。
blocks.en: Laboratory error ruled out: Phase I confirms that the deviation is real, so the investigation must move to the manufacturing side.

blocks.zh: Phase I 結論不確定（inconclusive）：無法排除也無法確認，保守原則要求繼續調查。
blocks.en: Phase I is inconclusive: laboratory error can be neither excluded nor confirmed, and the conservative principle requires the investigation to continue.

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯很重要——監管機構不接受「Phase I 沒找到問題就結案」的做法。
blocks.en: This logic matters - regulators do not accept closing a case just because Phase I did not find a problem.

blocks.zh: 比喻：跨部門調查像犯罪現場重建
blocks.en: Analogy: a cross-functional investigation is like reconstructing a crime scene

blocks.zh: 想像一件精密竊盜案——你需要鑑識人員（QC微生物）、建築專家（工程）、保全紀錄（製造記錄）、維修日誌（維護）一起拼圖。缺任何一個部門，就可能遺漏關鍵線索。QCU 扮演的是首席調查員角色，負責最終裁定和通報管理層。
blocks.en: Imagine a sophisticated burglary: you need forensic examiners (QC Microbiology), building experts (Engineering), security records (manufacturing records) and maintenance logs (Maintenance) to piece it together. If any one department is missing, key clues may be overlooked. The QCU acts as the lead investigator, responsible for the final decision and for notifying management.

blocks.zh: 重點：調查範圍擴大的判斷
blocks.en: Key point: deciding when to widen the scope of the investigation

blocks.zh: 「確定所有涉及批次」是第一個行動項目，原因很實際：如果同一條生產線的上下批次也受影響，卻已放行出貨，風險就外溢到市場。CDMO 的挑戰在於同一設施可能同時跑多個客戶的產品，一旦確定共用設備，範圍可能迅速擴大至跨客戶批次。
blocks.en: "Identify all batches involved" is the first action item, for a very practical reason: if the batches before and after on the same production line are also affected but have already been released, the risk spills over to the market. The challenge for a CDMO is that the same facility may run products for several clients at the same time, so once shared equipment is identified, the scope can quickly expand to batches across clients.

blocks.zh: 調查工具箱
blocks.en: Investigation toolbox

blocks.zh: TR88 列出多種 RCA 工具，以下是在無菌製造中最常用的：
blocks.en: TR88 lists a number of RCA tools; these are the ones most commonly used in sterile manufacturing:

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Fishbone / Ishikawa）：視覺化因果關係，6M 框架，第 5.1 節詳述。
blocks.en: Fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram: visualizes cause-and-effect relationships using the 6M framework; described in detail in Section 5.1.

blocks.zh: 5-Why 技術：適合因果鏈清晰的偏差，追問五層「為什麼」。
blocks.en: 5-Why technique: suits deviations with a clear causal chain; ask "why" five levels deep.

blocks.zh: FMEA：偏差重複出現時，評估系統性失效模式。
blocks.en: FMEA: when a deviation keeps recurring, evaluates systemic failure modes.

blocks.zh: Brainstorming：跨部門腦力激盪，確保不遺漏罕見場景。
blocks.en: Brainstorming: cross-functional brainstorming to make sure rare scenarios are not missed.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：你的 CDMO 有幾個薄弱點？
blocks.en: In practice: where are the weak points at your CDMO?

blocks.zh: 對照上方 11 項必要行動，思考以下問題：
blocks.en: Compare against the 11 required actions above and think through the following questions:

blocks.zh: 你的調查 SOP 是否明確規定「何種情況暫停生產」的決策門檻？
blocks.en: Does your investigation SOP clearly define the decision threshold for "when to stop production"?

blocks.zh: 跨批次影響評估是否有標準格式，還是每次調查員自行判斷？
blocks.en: Is there a standard format for assessing cross-batch impact, or does each investigator use their own judgment?

blocks.zh: 批次記錄資料審查是否涵蓋「意圖性資料篡改」的查核點？
blocks.en: Does the batch record data review include checkpoints for intentional data falsification?

blocks.zh: 5.1 Root Cause Analysis — 根本原因分析
blocks.en: 5.1 Root Cause Analysis

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 根本原因分析框架
blocks.en: Commentary - Root Cause Analysis Framework

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Fishbone / Ishikawa Diagram）
blocks.en: Fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖又稱石川圖，形狀像一條魚：
blocks.en: The fishbone diagram, also called the Ishikawa diagram, is shaped like a fish:

blocks.zh: 魚頭 = 問題（偏差本身，例如：EM 超標）
blocks.en: Head = the problem (the deviation itself, for example an EM excursion)

blocks.zh: 主骨 = 六大類別（6M）
blocks.en: Main spine = the six categories (6M)

blocks.zh: 小刺 = 每個類別下的具體因素
blocks.en: Small bones = the specific factors under each category

blocks.zh: 無菌製造中的 6M 對應如下：
blocks.en: The 6M categories map to sterile manufacturing as follows:

blocks.zh: Man（人員）：培訓、著裝、行為
blocks.en: Man (people): training, gowning, behavior

blocks.zh: Machine（設備）：HVAC、填充機、滅菌器
blocks.en: Machine (equipment): HVAC, filling machine, sterilizer

blocks.zh: Material（物料）：原料、包材、清潔劑
blocks.en: Material: raw materials, packaging components, cleaning agents

blocks.zh: Method（方法）：SOP、製程步驟
blocks.en: Method: SOPs, process steps

blocks.zh: Measurement（量測）：EM 方法、培養基、採樣技術
blocks.en: Measurement: EM methods, culture media, sampling technique

blocks.zh: Environment（環境）：壓差、溫度、潔淨室設計
blocks.en: Environment: differential pressure, temperature, cleanroom design

blocks.zh: 比喻：「已排除項目」也要記錄
blocks.en: Analogy: "ruled-out items" must be documented too

blocks.zh: 這一點常被新手忽略。想像你是偵探：你排查了所有嫌疑人，最後鎖定一人。但如果你沒有記錄為何排除其他人，審判時法官會質疑你的調查是否完整。監管機構的邏輯相同——FDA 或 EMA 查核時，會問「你有沒有評估 XYZ？」如果調查報告裡沒有提到，就等於沒做過。
blocks.en: Newcomers often overlook this point. Imagine you are a detective: you check every suspect and finally settle on one. But if you did not record why you excluded the others, the judge will question whether your investigation was complete. Regulators think the same way - during an FDA or EMA inspection they will ask, "Did you evaluate XYZ?" If the investigation report does not mention it, it is as if it was never done.

blocks.zh: 重點：調查深度要隨情境調整
blocks.en: Key point: adjust the depth of the investigation to the situation

blocks.zh: TR88 明確說明，6M 類別可以根據以下因素調整範圍：
blocks.en: TR88 states clearly that the scope of the 6M categories can be adjusted according to the following factors:

blocks.zh: 劑型（注射劑 vs. 口服固體）
blocks.en: Dosage form (injectable vs. oral solid)

blocks.zh: 設施設計（隔離器 vs. 開放式潔淨室）
blocks.en: Facility design (isolator vs. open cleanroom)

blocks.zh: 偏差本身的性質（單點事件 vs. 趨勢）
blocks.en: Nature of the deviation itself (single event vs. trend)

blocks.zh: 採樣位置（ISO 5 vs. ISO 8）
blocks.en: Sampling location (ISO 5 vs. ISO 8)

blocks.zh: 這給了調查員合理的彈性，但也意味著你必須在報告中說明「為何某類別不適用」，不能省略不提。
blocks.en: This gives investigators reasonable flexibility, but it also means you must explain in the report "why a category does not apply"; you cannot simply leave it out.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：CDMO 的魚骨圖挑戰
blocks.en: In practice: fishbone challenges at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，同一設施可能有多個客戶的製程同時運作。當偏差發生時，魚骨圖的「Material」骨可能需要同時考慮：你自己採購的物料、客戶提供的 API、共用清潔劑——每條供應鏈都是獨立的污染路徑。
blocks.en: At a CDMO, the processes of several clients may be running in the same facility at the same time. When a deviation occurs, the "Material" bone of the fishbone may need to cover all of the following: materials you purchased yourself, API supplied by the client, and shared cleaning agents - each supply chain is an independent contamination pathway.

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 — Factors to Consider in Root Cause Analysis（根本原因分析考量因素表）
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 - Factors to Consider in Root Cause Analysis

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — Table 5.1-1🔍 十大類別
blocks.en: Commentary - Table 5.1-1🔍: the ten categories

blocks.zh: 為什麼每個類別都必須評估？
blocks.en: Why must every category be evaluated?

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 是 TR88 的核心工具之一。它不是選單——而是強制清單。即使你認為某類別「不可能是原因」，仍必須評估並記錄排除理由。監管機構的期望是：調查報告讀完後，審查員不應有任何「這個有沒有考慮到？」的疑問。
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 is one of the core tools in TR88. It is not a menu - it is a mandatory checklist. Even if you believe a category "cannot possibly be the cause", you must still evaluate it and document the reason for excluding it. The regulatory expectation is that after reading the investigation report, a reviewer should have no lingering question of "was this considered?"

blocks.zh: 比喻：Table 5.1-1🔍 是飛行前檢查清單
blocks.en: Analogy: Table 5.1-1🔍 is a pre-flight checklist

blocks.zh: 飛行員的 pre-flight checklist 即使飛了一千次，每次都要走一遍。不是因為每次都會出問題，而是因為「跳過一步」可能是致命的。Table 5.1-1🔍 的邏輯相同——微生物偏差的污染來源往往在不預期的地方。景觀整地（Landscaping）加了覆土後，入口附近孢子數量上升？這不是笑話，真實案例中有過。
blocks.en: A pilot runs through the pre-flight checklist every time, even after a thousand flights. It is not because something goes wrong every time, but because "skipping one step" can be fatal. Table 5.1-1🔍 follows the same logic - the source of contamination in a microbial deviation is often somewhere unexpected. Spore counts rising near the entrance after landscaping added new topsoil? That is not a joke; it has happened in real cases.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 特別需要注意的類別
blocks.en: Key points: categories that need special attention at a CDMO

blocks.zh: Raw Materials：CDMO 常見情境是客戶提供 API，但供應商是客戶指定的。一旦出問題，要追查供應商變更通知——這需要客戶的配合。
blocks.en: Raw Materials: a common CDMO scenario is that the client supplies the API, and the supplier is designated by the client. If a problem occurs, supplier change notifications must be traced, which requires the client's cooperation.

blocks.zh: Personnel — Gowning：著裝是無菌製程中最常見的人為污染路徑。預濕濕紙巾（pre-wetted wipes）的開封後效期是一個容易被忽略的細節。
blocks.en: Personnel - Gowning: gowning is the most common route of human contamination in sterile processing. The in-use period of pre-wetted wipes after opening is an easily overlooked detail.

blocks.zh: Cleaning — Disinfectant Efficacy：消毒劑是否對偏差中鑑定的微生物有效？這是一個直接且關鍵的問題，特別是發現 Bacillus 孢子時，需要確認殺孢子劑（sporicidal agent）有效性。
blocks.en: Cleaning - Disinfectant Efficacy: is the disinfectant effective against the microorganism identified in the deviation? This is a direct and critical question, especially when Bacillus spores are found, where the efficacy of the sporicidal agent must be confirmed.

blocks.zh: Batch Records — Nonroutine Events：班次交接、設備中途更換、EM 超標後的緊急清潔——這些「非常規事件」是否都記錄在批次記錄中？
blocks.en: Batch Records - Nonroutine Events: are shift handovers, mid-process equipment changes and emergency cleaning after an EM excursion - these "nonroutine events" - all recorded in the batch record?

blocks.zh: 實務思考：你的調查模板涵蓋了幾個類別？
blocks.en: In practice: how many categories does your investigation template cover?

blocks.zh: 許多公司的調查表單只有 5-6 個類別，而 TR88 列出了 10 個。對照你目前使用的偏差調查模板，哪些類別是缺失的？特別值得補充的是：
blocks.en: Many companies' investigation forms have only 5-6 categories, whereas TR88 lists 10. Compare against the deviation investigation template you currently use: which categories are missing? Particularly worth adding:

blocks.zh: Material and Personnel Flow（物料與人員流向）
blocks.en: Material and Personnel Flow

blocks.zh: Gowning 子類別（著裝細節）
blocks.en: Gowning subcategory (gowning details)

blocks.zh: Cleaning — IPA 揮發性過期問題
blocks.en: Cleaning - IPA volatility and expiry issues

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-2🔍 — Root Cause Evaluation and Follow-Up（根本原因評估與後續追蹤）
blocks.en: Table 5.1-2🔍 - Root Cause Evaluation and Follow-Up

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 影響評估與結論等級
blocks.en: Commentary - Impact Assessment and Conclusion Levels

blocks.zh: 四種調查結論等級
blocks.en: The four investigation conclusion levels

blocks.zh: TR88 明確區分四個等級，這在監管溝通中非常重要：
blocks.en: TR88 clearly distinguishes four levels, which is very important in communication with regulators:

blocks.zh: Root Cause（根本原因）：高確定性，有直接證據支持。是最理想的結論，但在微生物偏差中不易達到。
blocks.en: Root Cause: high certainty, supported by direct evidence. This is the ideal conclusion, but it is hard to reach in microbial deviations.

blocks.zh: Most Probable Cause（最可能原因）：最可能的原因，但無法 100% 確認。這是監管機構在實務上最常接受的結論等級。
blocks.en: Most Probable Cause: the most likely cause, but one that cannot be confirmed 100%. This is the conclusion level regulators accept most often in practice.

blocks.zh: Possible Cause（可能原因）：有可能，但證據不足以確認，需要更多資料。
blocks.en: Possible Cause: plausible, but the evidence is not sufficient to confirm it and more data are needed.

blocks.zh: Unknown Cause（未知原因）：資料不足以得出任何結論。這是最難對監管機構交代的結論，必須伴隨強而有力的 CAPA。
blocks.en: Unknown Cause: the data are not sufficient to draw any conclusion. This is the hardest conclusion to justify to regulators and must be accompanied by a strong CAPA.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「最可能原因」是法律上的合理懷疑標準
blocks.en: Analogy: "most probable cause" is like a legal standard of reasonable doubt

blocks.zh: 「Most Probable Cause」就像刑事訴訟中的「合理懷疑排除」（beyond reasonable doubt）——不需要百分之百確定，但你的論據必須足夠有說服力，讓審查員認為這個解釋是合理的。關鍵在於：你的 CAPA 必須直接針對這個最可能原因，而不是泛泛而論的「加強培訓」。
blocks.en: "Most Probable Cause" is like "beyond reasonable doubt" in a criminal trial - you do not need to be 100% certain, but your argument must be convincing enough for the reviewer to accept the explanation as reasonable. The key is that your CAPA must target this most probable cause directly, rather than a generic "strengthen training".

blocks.zh: 重點：病患風險評估的層次
blocks.en: Key point: the layers of patient risk assessment

blocks.zh: Impact Assessment 要求從多個維度評估病患風險：
blocks.en: The impact assessment requires patient risk to be evaluated across several dimensions:

blocks.zh: 給藥途徑：注射劑（靜脈、肌肉）風險遠高於口服或外用。
blocks.en: Route of administration: injectables (intravenous, intramuscular) carry far greater risk than oral or topical products.

blocks.zh: 目標族群：免疫功能受損（immunocompromised）、兒科、術後患者屬高風險族群。
blocks.en: Target population: immunocompromised, pediatric and post-operative patients are high-risk groups.

blocks.zh: 微生物毒力：即使不直接致病，也可能產毒素、降解 API、改變黏度或變色。
blocks.en: Microbial virulence: even if it is not directly pathogenic, a microorganism may produce toxins, degrade the API, change viscosity or cause discoloration.

blocks.zh: 抗藥性：如果產品本身含抗生素，分離到的微生物是否有抗藥性？這直接影響療效評估。
blocks.en: Antimicrobial resistance: if the product itself contains an antibiotic, is the isolated microorganism resistant? This directly affects the assessment of efficacy.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，最終風險評估通常需要客戶（MAH）參與，因為他們掌握目標族群的臨床資料。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the final risk assessment usually needs the involvement of the client (MAH), because they hold the clinical data on the target population.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：你如何判斷結論等級？
blocks.en: In practice: how do you decide the conclusion level?

blocks.zh: 下次撰寫調查報告時，在「結論」章節明確標示所達到的等級（Root Cause / Most Probable Cause / Possible / Unknown），並列出支持此等級的證據清單。這個做法能讓 FDA/EMA 審查員一眼看出你的調查深度，也能讓你自己在後續 CAPA 設計中更有針對性。
blocks.en: The next time you write an investigation report, state clearly in the "Conclusion" section which level was reached (Root Cause / Most Probable Cause / Possible / Unknown), and list the evidence that supports that level. This lets FDA/EMA reviewers see the depth of your investigation at a glance, and helps you target the CAPA design that follows.

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-3🔍 — CAPA Determination（矯正預防措施計畫）
blocks.en: Table 5.1-3🔍 - CAPA Determination

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — CAPA 計畫要素
blocks.en: Commentary - CAPA Plan Elements

blocks.zh: CAPA 的三個核心要素
blocks.en: Three core elements of CAPA

blocks.zh: 一個有效的 CAPA 計畫必須具備：
blocks.en: An effective CAPA plan must be:

blocks.zh: 針對性（Targeted）：CAPA 必須直接消除已確認的根本原因或最可能原因，而非泛泛的「加強員工意識」。
blocks.en: Targeted: the CAPA must directly eliminate the confirmed root cause or most probable cause, rather than a generic "raise employee awareness".

blocks.zh: 可追蹤（Trackable）：每個行動項目必須有明確的到期日、責任人，並在電子化偏差管理系統中追蹤。
blocks.en: Trackable: every action item must have a clear due date and owner, and be tracked in an electronic deviation management system.

blocks.zh: 有效性可驗證（Verifiable）：CAPA 關閉後，必須有一個時間點進行 Effectiveness Check，確認偏差未復發。
blocks.en: Verifiable: after the CAPA is closed, there must be a defined point in time for an effectiveness check to confirm that the deviation has not recurred.

blocks.zh: 比喻：CAPA 就像外科手術後的追蹤門診
blocks.en: Analogy: CAPA is like a follow-up clinic visit after surgery

blocks.zh: 手術（即時矯正措施）完成後，患者需要追蹤門診確認傷口癒合、功能恢復。Effectiveness Check 就是追蹤門診——你不能開完刀就結案，必須確認患者真的痊癒了。如果六個月後偏差復發，代表手術可能治標不治本，需要重新評估根因。
blocks.en: Once the surgery (the immediate corrective action) is done, the patient needs a follow-up visit to confirm that the wound has healed and function has recovered. The effectiveness check is that follow-up visit - you cannot close the case right after the operation; you must confirm the patient has really recovered. If the deviation recurs six months later, the surgery may have treated the symptom but not the cause, and the root cause needs to be re-evaluated.

blocks.zh: 重點：Process Owner 的買入（Buy-In）
blocks.en: Key point: process owner buy-in

blocks.zh: TR88 特別強調 CAPA 需要「與流程負責人達成共識」。這不是官僚程序，而是實務需求：如果製造部門沒有認同某項 CAPA，即使在系統中標記完成，實際執行可能打折扣。質量部門的角色是促成共識，而非單方面指定行動。CDMO 環境中，部分 CAPA 可能還需要客戶批准（如製程變更），這會影響時間軸規劃。
blocks.en: TR88 specifically stresses that CAPA needs "agreement with the process owner". This is not bureaucracy but a practical necessity: if the manufacturing department does not accept a CAPA, then even if it is marked complete in the system, the actual execution may be watered down. The role of the quality unit is to build consensus, not to assign actions unilaterally. In a CDMO setting, some CAPAs may also need client approval (such as process changes), which affects timeline planning.

blocks.zh: 重點：警戒線與行動限制的重新評估
blocks.en: Key point: re-evaluating alert levels and action limits

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-3🔍 提到要確認現行的 Alert Level 和 Action Limit 是否仍適當。這是一個容易被忽略的 CAPA 方向——有時候偏差的根因不是污染事件本身，而是限制設定過於寬鬆，導致趨勢惡化時沒有及早介入。定期重新評估監控限制，是成熟 EM 程序的標誌。
blocks.en: Table 5.1-3🔍 mentions confirming whether the current alert level and action limit are still appropriate. This is an easily overlooked CAPA direction - sometimes the root cause of a deviation is not the contamination event itself, but limits that are set too loosely, so that no early intervention occurs when a trend worsens. Periodically re-evaluating monitoring limits is the mark of a mature EM program.

blocks.zh: 實務思考：你的電子系統能做到什麼？
blocks.en: In practice: what can your electronic system do?

blocks.zh: TR88 明確建議使用電子化調查資料庫追蹤 CAPA。評估你目前的系統：
blocks.en: TR88 clearly recommends using an electronic investigation database to track CAPAs. Evaluate your current system:

blocks.zh: 系統能否自動提醒 CAPA 到期日？
blocks.en: Can the system automatically remind users of CAPA due dates?

blocks.zh: 能否追蹤延遲執行的理由與授權記錄？
blocks.en: Can it track the reasons for delayed execution, together with the authorization records?

blocks.zh: 能否設定 Effectiveness Check 的自動到期提醒？
blocks.en: Can it set automatic due-date reminders for effectiveness checks?

blocks.zh: 能否跨批次、跨產品進行趨勢分析，識別 CAPA 失效模式？
blocks.en: Can it perform trend analysis across batches and products to identify CAPA failure modes?

blocks.zh: 如果現有系統缺乏這些功能，這本身就是一個值得提出的系統改善 CAPA。
blocks.en: If the current system lacks these functions, that in itself is a systems improvement worth raising as a CAPA.

blocks.zh: 章節摘要 — Section 5a: Phase II Root Cause Analysis
blocks.en: Section Summary - Section 5a: Phase II Root Cause Analysis

blocks.zh: Phase II 啟動條件：Phase I 無法排除實驗室錯誤，或確認偏差為真實事件——兩種情況均需啟動製造調查。
blocks.en: Phase II triggers: Phase I cannot rule out laboratory error, or confirms the deviation as a real event - either case requires a manufacturing investigation.

blocks.zh: 跨部門調查團隊：QCU 主導，成員涵蓋製造、工程、維護、製程驗證、品管，微生物 SME 參與至關重要。
blocks.en: Cross-functional investigation team: led by the QCU, with members from manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, process validation and quality control; the involvement of a microbiology SME is essential.

blocks.zh: 11 項必要調查行動：從確定批次範圍、根本原因分析、影響評估、風險評估，到 CAPA、溝通、區域巡查、趨勢分析，每一項都不可省略。
blocks.en: 11 required investigation actions: from determining batch scope, root cause analysis, impact assessment and risk assessment, to CAPA, communication, area walk-through and trend analysis - none may be omitted.

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖 6M 框架：Man、Machine、Material、Method、Measurement、Environment——無菌製造 RCA 的結構化起點。
blocks.en: Fishbone 6M framework: Man, Machine, Material, Method, Measurement, Environment - a structured starting point for RCA in sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 十大類別：原料、人員培訓（含著裝）、設施、空調供氣、物料人員流向、環境監控、清潔消毒、設備儀器、製程程序、批次記錄——全部必須評估並記錄。
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 ten categories: raw materials, personnel training (including gowning), facility, HVAC air supply, material and personnel flow, environmental monitoring, cleaning and disinfection, equipment and instruments, process procedures, batch records - all must be evaluated and documented.

blocks.zh: 四種結論等級：Root Cause（確定）→ Most Probable Cause（最可能，監管實務最常見）→ Possible Cause（可能）→ Unknown（未知）——每個等級對 CAPA 設計的要求不同。
blocks.en: Four conclusion levels: Root Cause (confirmed) → Most Probable Cause (most likely; the most common in regulatory practice) → Possible Cause → Unknown - each level places different requirements on CAPA design.

blocks.zh: 病患風險評估：給藥途徑、目標族群（免疫受損）、微生物毒力、抗藥性——這些維度決定偏差的嚴重程度和批次處置決策。
blocks.en: Patient risk assessment: route of administration, target population (immunocompromised), microbial virulence and antimicrobial resistance - these dimensions determine the severity of the deviation and the batch disposition decision.

blocks.zh: CAPA 計畫三要素：針對性（對應根因）、可追蹤（電子系統、責任人、到期日）、有效性可驗證（Effectiveness Check）。
blocks.en: Three elements of a CAPA plan: targeted (addresses the root cause), trackable (electronic system, owners, due dates) and verifiable (effectiveness check).
